description: Defines the PreProcessingSession class for managing audio effect pre-processing sessions, including creation, lookup, and release of sessions, with internal data structures and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: PreProcessingSession
classes.description: Manages all effect pre-processing sessions, providing singleton access, session creation, and release functionalities.

methods.name: getPreProcessingSession
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PreProcessingSession.

methods.name: findPreProcessingTypeInList
methods.description: Finds a pre-processing type in a list of contexts, optionally removing it.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new pre-processing session of a specific type, with given parameters.

methods.name: releaseSession
methods.description: Releases a session of a specific type and session ID.
